queries.query: CREATE CONSTRAINT p5_scoped_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:P5Node) REQUIRE (n.dataset, n.id) IS UNIQUE
UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n:P5Node {dataset:$dataset,id:row.id}) SET n:ADVICE_SUMMARY SET n += row.props RETURN count(n) AS count

5","ADVICEITEM-e4c79ea5bb9daedeef45","ADVICEITEM-e9d0b388c0a903dd9320"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-41c6d7a3c451d6146c4d","RULE-01912c8f6680befcbf9a","RULE-0907c9c0208233e15fcb","RULE-1ffcc4a483381e094329","RULE-60b714fe84aac65a5e95","RULE-6431e7fbbdc652169c23","RULE-6c2720da761fde27ab9a","RULE-a9d73bf71d079dd81967","RULE-be937adab5c1f40c7777","RULE-d0d47aeed6dbb8084476","RULE-eeacd9b5b5fb912f7380","RULE-f194b651ddeed3622fbd"],"summary":"历史资料记载，九寨沟全天建议预留7—9小时，也有资料直接写7—9小时；有游客8点45进园区、18:10才出沟，最后接近3万步。九寨沟两天看着观光车坐得多，其实中间一直在下车、走栈道、逛海子，一天下来活动量并不小。一天的游览对体能有所要求，来到九寨沟的第一天晚上可以好好休息；建议合理安排体力，景区很大，合理安排体力。由于一天时间相对紧凑，建议早上早点出发进入景区；也有游客建议07:30到景区。去九寨沟不要把路线排太满、要算好换乘，避免进沟以后一直赶车赶路；秋天来九寨沟别把行程排太满，挑几个喜欢的海子慢慢逛。九寨沟范围很大，主要靠观光车+步行串联，鞋子舒服、行程留白，比一天塞很多点更重要。","topic_id":"THEME-1e4c20d4d3aa0c8e7e52"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-54159dd45e739e0c","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-cb24680dd82e15c1","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-cb24680dd82e15c1","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"天数与黄龙取舍","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-5352b141a5811df6\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-08168cee056cf9730e54","ADVICEITEM-0ff0b73bca1ca8c793da","ADVICEITEM-36000aef7d194c409257","ADVICEITEM-8fa333d664c6a044dbac","ADVICEITEM-e12c34b285a76b85c806"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-19f1d14a41971508527b","RULE-275dbec636908b2fd6e0","RULE-4c3685809894bf15cf3c","RULE-9113d35a8f830f65fa70","RULE-ad09716217fc3acececd"],"summary":"历史资料记载，如果就两天，那两天就安排九寨两天；如果三天，那两天九寨一天黄龙也行。两天的时间对于游览九寨沟来说恰到好处。怕高反的话，黄龙可以不去，就玩九寨，更好看。有游客个人感觉黄龙确实没有九寨那么惊艳。","topic_id":"THEME-305f348b24ceb1a782f1"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-54159dd45e739e0c","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-cb24680dd82e15c1","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-cb24680dd82e15c1","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"高反与健康","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-2702478ab44b8901eb9e","ADVICEITEM-b6dcfe771d317ad24899","ADVICEITEM-c6eeca80d6466f792c8f"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-130a91c ce6985ba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，乘坐3号线或7号线至“汉溪长隆站”，从D/E口出站后换乘免费接驳巴士，可直达北门或南门，被认为最省心；也有说法称免费接驳巴士直达北门。官方资料提到出门乘坐免费巴士到达长隆野生动物世界北门。如需从南门前往北门，需要在南门下车后再换乘巴士。若通过公共交通前往长隆野生动物世界，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。","topic_id":"THEME-0c38c4d50c0788488e83"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"LEG-d3d78c378effc8c072a2","kind":"LEG"},{"id":"POI-11db8601a1e93894","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-20bcff6ec260b6ce","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-25d53e13a3ca790d","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-2e158f7f7465f6f2","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-41d5eefef861e525","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-73de67c9bb37b2da","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aa28ef8584e34841","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-b1f6b7b2ab56bf1d","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-dfe674a2b7c954bf","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-ebc9c6b6cc39c0aa","kind":"POI"},{"id":"ROUTEOBS-268d15efc68b5596","kind":"ROUTE"}],[{"id":"LEG-f37be9972668fe8f3f13","kind":"LEG"},{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}]],"label":"北门入园后的小火车与游览顺序","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-3383df925b9157f8\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-89b6b551e56237db\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-8b9707aaed9cf861\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-41c7c5c48b24a58da87b","ADVICEITEM-42735e21f18943bd278e","ADVICEITEM-493c5e078f0f15f94513","ADVICEITEM-be613154ad876669c32c","ADVICEITEM-d160b2a0f0f58f6a60bd"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a","RULE-69d9a2d5c8269628948a","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从北门入园，可先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。有游客建议北门直冲免费小火车；某游记行程中第二天从野生动物园小火车开始，北门进。另有游客给出一天游步行园区的路线：从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看老虎，下山后喂长颈鹿、看亚洲象园的大象，到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，再逛考拉园和熊猫村，然后前往熊猫乐园站乘坐缆车返回北门。","topic_id":"THEME-a944fd0511af3843f1bd"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"LEG-8f3405076da2a1f37c53","kind":"LEG"},{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"停车与到园时间","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-fa4f848ee09ffe04\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-0f6d00ede67ee896354c","ADVICEITEM-2932498b45f4028950bf","ADVICEITEM-4217cf33508f894ab84d","ADVICEITEM-a7eb8bd5d4727c4a35fb","ADVICEITEM-b4e797a69759fa2498fd","ADVICEITEM-b668fd3bd495e3144fa2","ADVICEITEM-f39a1a7fdb49175f3cb8"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-3eb8b8bcae9b633631bb","FACT-9b6b7c456512c5d1d698","RULE-0cc22f49a3e71af4cd9a","RULE-31bdee4b8d7cc97946c4","RULE-3975f8c932204246e940","RULE-72215311b50d55e5c634","RULE-e781cf50698fd7b575f4"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提醒转身就会发现停车场已被管制，得绕好远才能停好车；正确的路线应是北门进，将车停在北门，看到车位就停，别墨迹。另有游客描述从北门进时看到里面还有车位，工作人员指示往前开，于是驶过北门。时间方面，有建议08:50前到北门，赶上第一波进园早、体验好很多；节假日建议9点前到，避免堵车。还有一条提到09:00发车、09:30结束，条件是游客09:30才入园，原文未给出更多后果说明。","topic_id":"THEME-88c196b1367a147a5712"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aac7d90bfc5ff426","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"表演与避开人流","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-fa4f848ee09ffe04\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-1b1f08a2c1c452501381","ADVICEITEM-799576d41cab1cdd361d"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-1458f73ae93871761a8f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议从北门进，上午十一点半和下午五点南门有很多场表演，从北门进来两个点的表演都可以看到；也有建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团。","topic_id":"THEME-480980b6b1fd00997e3a"}]}

个大人一个小孩）。每年三四月份属于景区淡季，预订广州长隆酒店客房可以赠送野生动物园的两日票。","topic_id":"THEME-c8db79dc7e37edaa8d7b"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"安检与携带物品","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-0f2da2f89b38da106073","ADVICEITEM-16d049d4b9a869eb33ee","ADVICEITEM-226b7fa11e502e1fb447","ADVICEITEM-2fae4537ac53cdcb6f8d","ADVICEITEM-3c95ec575ab5050b8282","ADVICEITEM-493f506cf8e8a9feea3c","ADVICEITEM-4dfefb54c6b9b6f6828d","ADVICEITEM-557f54226b68cbfc2f20","ADVICEITEM-5b8ca8d824f43a9c3841","ADVICEITEM-92c1e9e8dd5ab1e15d8c","ADVICEITEM-cffdd4cb74811c96df18","ADVICEITEM-d4b72f2a5350c549363a","ADVICEITEM-f7d1cb4bd84bff859650","ADVICEITEM-fba331adb688197f9886"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-208ba10e0caecaae5040","FACT-6b1244376929040b4645","FACT-73919c621d381cd49cc9","FACT-7bc95a1f8bc1083f29ec","FACT-a00a7d9e908cd1ccb562","RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-1a7e7ccd70222c884868","RULE-2436cce1c5fecd978f86","RULE-285f2e364cf95899b602","RULE-400c59eb16935a59c77d","RULE-9196d4b4a9a46782d4a6","RULE-b69a609bd7355daaa5d0","RULE-c2851e7bac0fa27362ba","RULE-e0cb4c4bf3f3fa8d3cf9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，入园时有安检，进园工作人员会要求打开随身携带的包，看到食物会拿出来暂时保管。多条资料称不可以带食物进去，除了水不允许带别的食物；进入园区可以带水，但不能带入食品。也有游客表示只要不随地扔垃圾，带点食物进去是很有必要的，并称里面的东西很不好吃；另有冬天带食物进去的做法（夏天的话自己想办法）。关于投喂，有资料称一般应该是不允许自带食物去投喂动物的。","topic_id":"THEME-5bfc086793bfe23afe8b"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aac7d90bfc5ff426","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"开放时间与园区布局","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-46f34f7365e47e8a8747","ADVICEITEM-5fb0285473f380024a90","ADVICEITEM-92d120714a201182115c"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-0cdc24bbc1be47a2369c","RULE-11a1347eba22dc3e20fc","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955"],"summary":"历史资料记载，开园时间为09:30-18:00。动物园分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口。动物园内的表演多数集中在中午以后。","topic_id":"THEME-64279434cd282ec78e41"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"交通与入园顺序","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-3383df925b9157f8\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-6a4ffb8004f68f75\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-4f2b5e56aa365c07f18b","ADVICEITEM-b28281f483f7ef4dd5af","ADVICEITEM-bac76c530e160dbec9b1","ADVICEITEM-ddd7ee49fb1b0328434c","ADVICEITEM-ea87662e827cf6ab0590","ADVICEITEM-f176080b7d07fa0ddbb9"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-627e866a69829f85728b","RULE-7e17f5034798bdff5ed8","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba","RULE-d9dca83ab2e746b5b1c5"],"summary":"历史资料记载，如果虎门大桥不堵车，从深圳自驾走沿江高速一个半小时可以抵达；从特别远的停车场出发，步行到动物园至少得四十分钟。有游客建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团；如果通过公共交通前往，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。某游记行程中，第二天早晨坐小火车，然后一直在动物园逛；另一游记行程中，Day2野生动物园从小火车开始，北门进。","topic_id":"THEME-d0e345ff111a0b6d8718"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-25d53e13a3ca790d","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-78f05fe80a344b95","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-2e158f7f7465f6f2","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-73de67c9bb37b2da","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aa28ef8584e34841","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-78f05fe80a344b95","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-25e3bd181c2c2ab3","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"游玩方式与路线","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-023ef90cdaa90da847ee","ADVICEITEM-0b19a7d171fadf3a7fe0","ADVICEITEM-7b61a5b0c9eeddf74d78","ADVICEITEM-8188f70e03f19aa4c812","ADVICEITEM-9f1b44e882f09a733327","ADVICEITEM-a1e38e74d291bb4b7ee6","ADVICEITEM-a957fdcc21ca103992ab","ADVICEITEM-ad056753641bd40f84da","ADVICEITEM-cb63d19c79d7bd68ed4f","ADVICEITEM-cfd13e2a80230295a3ef","ADVICEITEM-d6332fc6281326c31648","ADVICEITEM-da3870ddd486fe9e3075","ADVICEITEM-e7f79a78266c9499a324","ADVICEITEM-ec65ee5c3b7d24601014"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-7d4b37c98aa282d1eaa1","RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-05c213fb0912d16b3704","RULE-08b6eb16f48fb0ac5548","RULE-1d2aa2add689a41d11a2","RULE-2950e5f05577e42d9f6a","RULE-2c2fff9a5cac67877127","RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd","RULE-5860c229375c56f5f824","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-95091aac46254dbe384a","RULE-a1b228868709cae375d8","RULE-b1f0f8a55aa7e1a92457","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议第一天主要步行游览；第二天由于体力已经消耗得比较厉害，安排早上自驾游，下午观看表演及动物科普。步行游览区重点是考拉、熊猫、白虎所在中心园区，其他的可以顺路看。野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看；其次考虑乘坐小火车游览，一次没看够可以多次看。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对值得，Mio选择的自驾游也成为此行最赞的部分之一。空中缆车本来就是要坐的，如果能碰巧坐到透明底座的就很幸运。如果不想排队，建议购买快捷通道的门票，还是很划算的。开车入园的话，里面有自驾区，一台车是一张票的价格。提前不做攻略会搞得焦头烂额，建议提前做攻略。","topic_id":"THEME-74e6fb18c9c162a64aee"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-db5b34348b0b1b08","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"适合人群与亲子服务","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-0204f93aa102a2975b43","ADVICEITEM-130804c35ac00f03671e","ADVICEITEM-1a219f4521e54f2c6f24","ADVICEITEM-1f1cd51f93724ff9fb9b","ADVICEITEM-8e096abd648d0c6ab0eb","ADVICEITEM-99b1e691455f7264ea1a","ADVICEITEM-d049d53d63a03dc05dd3","ADVICEITEM-dfa12772952f1f416bf5","ADVICEITEM-eca6beb3eb769ae3a0da"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-1005d24c799299a1d106","RULE-204db30e69bb1fd7283e","RULE-55fde43696bc0d6c7840","RULE-6ec1c7c5b585ba3a6097","RULE-96dd8cf8bb92945073a3","RULE-a7b5d0e0ce97116bc06c","RULE-c7b17986142f58c174a7","RULE-cc99c9ef68efd3a7eef4","RULE-cf1bd2edf0d67a826f14"],"summary":"历史资料记载，没来过的一定要带孩子来玩玩；更适合情侣和家庭亲子。如果是带宝宝前来游玩，最重要的一件事是带他们去学习动物世界内的科普课程；在每个动物的展区附近，景区都特意开设了面向中、小学生的拯救濒危动物科普教育活动。带6岁以下小孩去，建议租辆婴儿车；也有游客称婴儿车很有必要租。园内有童车租赁服务，对外地游客十分方便，租车使用现金，不支持微信、支付宝。野生动物世界内还有适合小朋友游玩的儿童版跳伞塔、碰碰车和旋转木马等设施，适合亲子互动。对于希望深度游览园区每个角落、体验每个活动的深度游览者，可能需要更加详细的资料。","topic_id":"THEME-d66625c4e0b6610aa381"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"表演与推车限制","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-5fff882c17f4ddc50b5a","ADVICEITEM-a4f6943855254e8d7fba"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-5200e6f5a782b4431f48","RULE-d93500386820bfe0297f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，所有表演的地方都不可以推车入场；看表演时将车锁在外面栏杆处即可。","topic_id":"THEME-06658c30fa6ccf87c3c6"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-dfe674a2b7c954bf","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"餐饮与购物","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-684ba7b548292acf67c0","ADVICEITEM-96c92bea9b0ab8452a05","ADVICEITEM-cffdd4cb74811c96df18"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-35eead19b065347c0f12","RULE-83b8f895325cc81e9f2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物世界推荐熊猫餐厅。有游客建议带点食物进去，并称里面的东西很不好吃。在野生动物世界内的小铺子可以买可爱的“萌态”动物玩具、特色物品留念，售价不贵、性价比高，许多玩偶在外面买不到，小朋友很喜欢，有游客建议一定要去“买买买”。","topic_id":"THEME-4481b71ba8d6f33e5d1e"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"行程安排与周边体验","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-076a467e186433e9\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-6a4ffb8004f68f75\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-878eeeffc455947701d1","ADVICEITEM-8aa56d11ef41d7ad30a0","ADVICEITEM-926ef566af0d23750529","ADVICEITEM-a267da170f9655e74cf4","ADVICEITEM-a2b039c6c96839eab935","ADVICEITEM-ba9644948647ae4ae062"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-198342f346929f7bc0b5","RULE-29434f65777e7f638d12","RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-39da5c309c279374afb7","RULE-a5b878146e6ef6117bae","RULE-d76f0b3e2311cca512ad","RULE-f491e7a2544f1e466fba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，大部分人去长隆野生动物世界基本是周末或者假期，算上往返和住宿大约两天时间，这份攻略比较适用于大部分普通游客。如果起晚了，可以参考某游记第三天的行程，一个家长带着娃逛动物园，一个家长退房存行李。某游记行程中，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演。有游客表示长隆野生动物世界确实值得一去；趁着南方金秋好天气，可以带上宝贝来一场与动物们的亲密接触；也有官方宣传语称带上你爱的人来长隆野生动物世界数动物，顺便来一场浪漫的空中告白。","topic_id":"THEME-f4cf3ec974920689dd10"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"开园历史","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-42ecebba08811056a5a7"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-3d6b1ee7e615c8e23aa7"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆野生动物世界于1997年开园。","topic_id":"THEME-25e414e0c4b7c0327d9a"}]},"method":"lossless_aggregation_plus_llm_themes_v2","scenic_code":"GZCL","scope_meaning":"registered_target","scope_status":null,"semantic_merge_completed":true,"source_document_count":11,"source_record_ids":["FACT-208ba10e0caecaae5040","FACT-6b1244376929040b4645","FACT-73919c621d381cd49cc9","FACT-7bc95a1f8bc1083f29ec","FACT-7d4b37c98aa282d1eaa1","FACT-a00a7d9e908cd1ccb562","RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-05c213fb0912d16b3704","RULE-08b6eb16f48fb0ac5548","RULE-0cdc24bbc1be47a2369c","RULE-0ee006777ba81c692da6","RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-1005d24c799299a1d106","RULE-118d803082fbe0ba5356","RULE-11a1347eba22dc3e20fc","RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-1653cc26102c13218873","RULE-198342f346929f7bc0b5","RULE-1a7e7ccd70222c884868","RULE-1d2aa2add689a41d11a2","RULE-1dd65a8474dcf69f36e9","RULE-204db30e69bb1fd7283e","RULE-229fb315a7bf4e7aab37","RULE-2436cce1c5fecd978f86","RULE-285f2e364cf95899b602","RULE-29434f6577 FACT-73919c621d381cd49cc9","FACT-7bc95a1f8bc1083f29ec","FACT-a00a7d9e908cd1ccb562","RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-1a7e7ccd70222c884868","RULE-2436cce1c5fecd978f86","RULE-285f2e364cf95899b602","RULE-400c59eb16935a59c77d","RULE-9196d4b4a9a46782d4a6","RULE-b69a609bd7355daaa5d0","RULE-c2851e7bac0fa27362ba","RULE-e0cb4c4bf3f3fa8d3cf9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，入园时有安检，进园工作人员会要求打开随身携带的包，看到食物会拿出来暂时保管。多条资料称不可以带食物进去，除了水不允许带别的食物；进入园区可以带水，但不能带入食品。也有游客表示只要不随地扔垃圾，带点食物进去是很有必要的，并称里面的东西很不好吃；另有冬天带食物进去的做法（夏天的话自己想办法）。关于投喂，有资料称一般应该是不允许自带食物去投喂动物的。","topic_id":"THEME-5bfc086793bfe23afe8b"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aac7d90bfc5ff426","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"开放时间与园区布局","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-46f34f7365e47e8a8747","ADVICEITEM-5fb0285473f380024a90","ADVICEITEM-92d120714a201182115c"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-0cdc24bbc1be47a2369c","RULE-11a1347eba22dc3e20fc","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955"],"summary":"历史资料记载，开园时间为09:30-18:00。动物园分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口。动物园内的表演多数集中在中午以后。","topic_id":"THEME-64279434cd282ec78e41"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"交通与入园顺序","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-3383df925b9157f8\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-6a4ffb8004f68f75\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-4f2b5e56aa365c07f18b","ADVICEITEM-b28281f483f7ef4dd5af","ADVICEITEM-bac76c530e160dbec9b1","ADVICEITEM-ddd7ee49fb1b0328434c","ADVICEITEM-ea87662e827cf6ab0590","ADVICEITEM-f176080b7d07fa0ddbb9"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-627e866a69829f85728b","RULE-7e17f5034798bdff5ed8","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba","RULE-d9dca83ab2e746b5b1c5"],"summary":"历史资料记载，如果虎门大桥不堵车，从深圳自驾走沿江高速一个半小时可以抵达；从特别远的停车场出发，步行到动物园至少得四十分钟。有游客建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团；如果通过公共交通前往，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。某游记行程中，第二天早晨坐小火车，然后一直在动物园逛；另一游记行程中，Day2野生动物园从小火车开始，北门进。","topic_id":"THEME-d0e345ff111a0b6d8718"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-25d53e13a3ca790d","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-78f05fe80a344b95","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-2e158f7f7465f6f2","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-73de67c9bb37b2da","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-aa28ef8584e34841","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-78f05fe80a344b95","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-9b5ed8e652f8e344","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"TRANSPORT-25e3bd181c2c2ab3","kind":"TRANSPORT"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"游玩方式与路线","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-023ef90cdaa90da847ee","ADVICEITEM-0b19a7d171fadf3a7fe0","ADVICEITEM-7b61a5b0c9eeddf74d78","ADVICEITEM-8188f70e03f19aa4c812","ADVICEITEM-9f1b44e882f09a733327","ADVICEITEM-a1e38e74d291bb4b7ee6","ADVICEITEM-a957fdcc21ca103992ab","ADVICEITEM-ad056753641bd40f84da","ADVICEITEM-cb63d19c79d7bd68ed4f","ADVICEITEM-cfd13e2a80230295a3ef","ADVICEITEM-d6332fc6281326c31648","ADVICEITEM-da3870ddd486fe9e3075","ADVICEITEM-e7f79a78266c9499a324","ADVICEITEM-ec65ee5c3b7d24601014"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-7d4b37c98aa282d1eaa1","RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-05c213fb0912d16b3704","RULE-08b6eb16f48fb0ac5548","RULE-1d2aa2add689a41d11a2","RULE-2950e5f05577e42d9f6a","RULE-2c2fff9a5cac67877127","RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd","RULE-5860c229375c56f5f824","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-95091aac46254dbe384a","RULE-a1b228868709cae375d8","RULE-b1f0f8a55aa7e1a92457","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议第一天主要步行游览；第二天由于体力已经消耗得比较厉害，安排早上自驾游，下午观看表演及动物科普。步行游览区重点是考拉、熊猫、白虎所在中心园区，其他的可以顺路看。野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看；其次考虑乘坐小火车游览，一次没看够可以多次看。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对值得，Mio选择的自驾游也成为此行最赞的部分之一。空中缆车本来就是要坐的，如果能碰巧坐到透明底座的就很幸运。如果不想排队，建议购买快捷通道的门票，还是很划算的。开车入园的话，里面有自驾区，一台车是一张票的价格。提前不做攻略会搞得焦头烂额，建议提前做攻略。","topic_id":"THEME-74e6fb18c9c162a64aee"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-db5b34348b0b1b08","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"适合人群与亲子服务","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-0204f93aa102a2975b43","ADVICEITEM-130804c35ac00f03671e","ADVICEITEM-1a219f4521e54f2c6f24","ADVICEITEM-1f1cd51f93724ff9fb9b","ADVICEITEM-8e096abd648d0c6ab0eb","ADVICEITEM-99b1e691455f7264ea1a","ADVICEITEM-d049d53d63a03dc05dd3","ADVICEITEM-dfa12772952f1f416bf5","ADVICEITEM-eca6beb3eb769ae3a0da"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-1005d24c799299a1d106","RULE-204db30e69bb1fd7283e","RULE-55fde43696bc0d6c7840","RULE-6ec1c7c5b585ba3a6097","RULE-96dd8cf8bb92945073a3","RULE-a7b5d0e0ce97116bc06c","RULE-c7b17986142f58c174a7","RULE-cc99c9ef68efd3a7eef4","RULE-cf1bd2edf0d67a826f14"],"summary":"历史资料记载，没来过的一定要带孩子来玩玩；更适合情侣和家庭亲子。如果是带宝宝前来游玩，最重要的一件事是带他们去学习动物世界内的科普课程；在每个动物的展区附近，景区都特意开设了面向中、小学生的拯救濒危动物科普教育活动。带6岁以下小孩去，建议租辆婴儿车；也有游客称婴儿车很有必要租。园内有童车租赁服务，对外地游客十分方便，租车使用现金，不支持微信、支付宝。野生动物世界内还有适合小朋友游玩的儿童版跳伞塔、碰碰车和旋转木马等设施，适合亲子互动。对于希望深度游览园区每个角落、体验每个活动的深度游览者，可能需要更加详细的资料。","topic_id":"THEME-d66625c4e0b6610aa381"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"表演与推车限制","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-5fff882c17f4ddc50b5a","ADVICEITEM-a4f6943855254e8d7fba"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-5200e6f5a782b4431f48","RULE-d93500386820bfe0297f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，所有表演的地方都不可以推车入场；看表演时将车锁在外面栏杆处即可。","topic_id":"THEME-06658c30fa6ccf87c3c6"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-dfe674a2b7c954bf","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"餐饮与购物","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-684ba7b548292acf67c0","ADVICEITEM-96c92bea9b0ab8452a05","ADVICEITEM-cffdd4cb74811c96df18"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-35eead19b065347c0f12","RULE-83b8f895325cc81e9f2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物世界推荐熊猫餐厅。有游客建议带点食物进去，并称里面的东西很不好吃。在野生动物世界内的小铺子可以买可爱的“萌态”动物玩具、特色物品留念，售价不贵、性价比高，许多玩偶在外面买不到，小朋友很喜欢，有游客建议一定要去“买买买”。","topic_id":"THEME-4481b71ba8d6f33e5d1e"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}],[{"id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"行程安排与周边体验","scope_bindings":["{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-076a467e186433e9\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{\"upstream_fragment_targets\":[{\"id\":\"ROUTEOBS-6a4ffb8004f68f75\",\"kind\":\"ROUTE\"}]}","{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-878eeeffc455947701d1","ADVICEITEM-8aa56d11ef41d7ad30a0","ADVICEITEM-926ef566af0d23750529","ADVICEITEM-a267da170f9655e74cf4","ADVICEITEM-a2b039c6c96839eab935","ADVICEITEM-ba9644948647ae4ae062"],"source_record_ids":["RULE-198342f346929f7bc0b5","RULE-29434f65777e7f638d12","RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-39da5c309c279374afb7","RULE-a5b878146e6ef6117bae","RULE-d76f0b3e2311cca512ad","RULE-f491e7a2544f1e466fba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，大部分人去长隆野生动物世界基本是周末或者假期，算上往返和住宿大约两天时间，这份攻略比较适用于大部分普通游客。如果起晚了，可以参考某游记第三天的行程，一个家长带着娃逛动物园，一个家长退房存行李。某游记行程中，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演。有游客表示长隆野生动物世界确实值得一去；趁着南方金秋好天气，可以带上宝贝来一场与动物们的亲密接触；也有官方宣传语称带上你爱的人来长隆野生动物世界数动物，顺便来一场浪漫的空中告白。","topic_id":"THEME-f4cf3ec974920689dd10"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[ 0a9","RULE-74f1fc201125132c8c33","RULE-8d82b408bb555acbb4fe","RULE-c59ecb4799438726f1d4"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有1大1小特惠亲子票；购买该1大1小亲子票时，请选定适用日期内其中一天为游玩日期。1名购票成人（大学生票、优待票等优惠票种除外）仅限携带1名身高未达1.0米的免票儿童入园。某游记提到买了海洋王国三天两晚的门票。","topic_id":"THEME-8a0a62d122d7a73c24a9"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a9df4e391f8f4dc5","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"游玩顺序与排队","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-81eb679bb9c5135da8c4","ADVICEITEM-8233a17f37b9ee8bcf9a","ADVICEITEM-991d05dce2caa3961e2d","ADVICEITEM-a314de325e2f680522fa","ADVICEITEM-a4b8ff0acde5f2909c21","ADVICEITEM-b6dbd0b89a270254e468","ADVICEITEM-c218daa0d9599a32107e","ADVICEITEM-c6b2d9b49bf79504efbb","ADVICEITEM-fdb2a2eaa17250c05ac0","ADVICEITEM-fdd21fa65c64995cdd08"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-9039df1f0e45390d087d","RULE-08bd617593460ffe0554","RULE-469a5cf141267317776a","RULE-4f025dd66f9432838eb6","RULE-933ec95dc40df77c3a13","RULE-a31d517e1ae3809402f5","RULE-bf555e35b58a4c35a9b7","RULE-cc2e59ee3d9f8f8d91fa","RULE-d73d185915d7e8b0f7cb","RULE-fd97867a639ad3be7c3f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，主推几个景点，一定要光速打卡，否则要排队排好久；某游记行程中第一天主攻看动物及各种表演。旺季进园需要排队至少半小时起。有游客表示长隆好跟多，不用挤人，又可以玩够看够，排队不超过30分钟；另有资料称我们过去刚好是小雨，每一个点都不用排队。在合理的规划下路线、安排好时间、做好功课时，不会错过园区的任何一处精彩。海洋王国的各个表演时间也可以在海洋王国的官网获取。有游客建议主打看海洋动物们，从从容容游玩；两天玩下来会比较轻松。","topic_id":"THEME-67ec7e4b4278ed419404"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"POI-a9df4e391f8f4dc5","kind":"POI"}]],"label":"天气、遮阴与装备","scope_bindings":["{}"],"source_item_ids":["ADVICEITEM-948d27103eb51def93cb","ADVICEITEM-9d5ca4d2880966295cb9","ADVICEITEM-dea992a4c788b0962f77"],"source_record_ids":["FACT-4e3c2b28065311868d62","RULE-731b83d3fe8cd0b21871","RULE-989f08e9a872e837976e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，并没有什么大树或者室内可以遮阴的地方；6月的午后实在是太晒了，大人小孩都有些受不了了。园区内租借的推车配有锁链，不用担心丢失。","topic_id":"THEME-586b2b1a10cff4ba0e62"},{"current_validity_verified":false,"joint_target_sets":[[{"id":"LEG-b51f52e8eedb53ee7cc3","kind":"LEG"},{"id":"POI-3ee90e175366fdcd","kind":"POI"},{"id":"POI-a9df4e391f8 {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"门票与座位","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-7e2ad8913e3226a0dfe8","RULE-a8c62a0db281cf3f04a0","RULE-d2ef181d56806f559849","RULE-dca1eacea754da8edc66"],"summary":"历史资料记载，酒店可以购买长隆大马戏门票，普通票座位先到先占，每位450元；如果购买有固定位置的VIP票，大概600多元。有游客表示，如果想要拍照，强烈推荐购买VIP座。另有资料建议对比台补3日通门票加大马戏门票。","topic_id":"THEME-7aa05273e9c24ed72963"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与到场时间","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-46d59eef160ac57a24b7","RULE-0435c3b0a925982d00e9","RULE-29c6f219045563b7867c","RULE-849d391551d877845266","RULE-c82bb1777a9a88c11650","RULE-f7801fc861f1a7810b5b"],"summary":"历史资料记载，一定要提早订票，人比较多；提前购票，包括马戏表演都要提前预定。大马戏一定要早到；节假日提早点入场。如果想要好位，建议5点左右去排队大马戏。","topic_id":"THEME-0269bca2fa286f563e8d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"演出内容与时长","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-2eb8e21a8daa3bd8d361","FACT-c2a9b23301760344330c","RULE-939cd2045e57985ec2fb","RULE-c2da4f4e49a2342a86bd","RULE-fcfdde6b8328de430dc9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆国际大马戏突破传统表演方式，融合中西不同演绎元素，水陆空多元化节目，舞蹈、杂技、魔术等应有尽有，节目丰富多彩；有游客表示演出互动性超强，去看一场何乐而不为，并称长隆大马戏也是不可放过的项目。演出时长有游客说一个多小时，也有游客说一个半小时左右。","topic_id":"THEME-32d4d7f351dfdf75bd11"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"行程安排与餐饮","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-4b6b782c5dd330b88507","RULE-8a9bc76bb99c96cd8947","RULE-9ae1a05083d64c42849a","RULE-adeecb322a0882d63ef1","RULE-e4261bbe6ef7797b172b"],"summary":"历史资料记载，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演；某游记建议傍晚留时间看大马戏。这个时间点出园，可以慢悠悠地去广州长隆国际大马戏吃个晚饭，还有占个好位置。比较推荐长隆野生动物世界的熊猫餐厅和长隆大马戏剧院的明星餐厅；如果不赶时间去看大马戏，建议考虑下自助晚餐。住熊猫酒店时，建议去大马戏或欢乐世界。","topic_id":"THEME-fd7215b4856f6146462d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"交通与步行","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-8f17dcd80769dea03e8b","RULE-dd67b65482720d1ec18e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，坐地铁到汉溪长隆地铁站，7号线还有3号线都可以到，下地铁之后从D出口或者E出口下，搭园区的免费穿梭巴士去到大戏剧院；另有资料称从熊猫酒店步行直达大马戏。","topic_id":"THEME-dc1d19dfd5e6911d0302"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"带娃与套餐条件","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-b2692df787868c4f85a0","RULE-c0ac2348b5260f478858"],"summary":"历史资料记载，提到“大马戏带娃”，但原文未给出具体建议或后果；另有“只有拍个3人套餐再单买一个大马戏了”的说法，原文也未给出具体后果。","topic_id":"THEME-fbd8104ab26f5bb42ec5"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"opening_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-9863b1f9af902c68"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"19:30开始"},{"attribute":"recommended_stay","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-b4315c2cd05d0f72"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"一个半小时左右"},{"attribute":"visit_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-b32b0da789b1f14f"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"晚上"},{"attribute":"reservation_requirement","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"recommended","observation_ids":["P5OBS-9ecf5272faca9f5d"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"提前预定"},{"attribute":"recommended_stay","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-4c9b67b9e7fa5d00"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"一个多小时"},{"attribute":"opening_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-0baa51d763ec4739","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-ddbe1b276273f81c"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"06:25检票"},{"attribute":"visit_time","con [{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"门票与座位","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-7e2ad8913e3226a0dfe8","RULE-a8c62a0db281cf3f04a0","RULE-d2ef181d56806f559849","RULE-dca1eacea754da8edc66"],"summary":"历史资料记载，酒店可以购买长隆大马戏门票，普通票座位先到先占，每位450元；如果购买有固定位置的VIP票，大概600多元。有游客表示，如果想要拍照，强烈推荐购买VIP座。另有资料建议对比台补3日通门票加大马戏门票。","topic_id":"THEME-7aa05273e9c24ed72963"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与到场时间","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-46d59eef160ac57a24b7","RULE-0435c3b0a925982d00e9","RULE-29c6f219045563b7867c","RULE-849d391551d877845266","RULE-c82bb1777a9a88c11650","RULE-f7801fc861f1a7810b5b"],"summary":"历史资料记载，一定要提早订票，人比较多；提前购票，包括马戏表演都要提前预定。大马戏一定要早到；节假日提早点入场。如果想要好位，建议5点左右去排队大马戏。","topic_id":"THEME-0269bca2fa286f563e8d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"演出内容与时长","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-2eb8e21a8daa3bd8d361","FACT-c2a9b23301760344330c","RULE-939cd2045e57985ec2fb","RULE-c2da4f4e49a2342a86bd","RULE-fcfdde6b8328de430dc9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆国际大马戏突破传统表演方式，融合中西不同演绎元素，水陆空多元化节目，舞蹈、杂技、魔术等应有尽有，节目丰富多彩；有游客表示演出互动性超强，去看一场何乐而不为，并称长隆大马戏也是不可放过的项目。演出时长有游客说一个多小时，也有游客说一个半小时左右。","topic_id":"THEME-32d4d7f351dfdf75bd11"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"行程安排与餐饮","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-4b6b782c5dd330b88507","RULE-8a9bc76bb99c96cd8947","RULE-9ae1a05083d64c42849a","RULE-adeecb322a0882d63ef1","RULE-e4261bbe6ef7797b172b"],"summary":"历史资料记载，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演；某游记建议傍晚留时间看大马戏。这个时间点出园，可以慢悠悠地去广州长隆国际大马戏吃个晚饭，还有占个好位置。比较推荐长隆野生动物世界的熊猫餐厅和长隆大马戏剧院的明星餐厅；如果不赶时间去看大马戏，建议考虑下自助晚餐。住熊猫酒店时，建议去大马戏或欢乐世界。","topic_id":"THEME-fd7215b4856f6146462d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"交通与步行","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-8f17dcd80769dea03e8b","RULE-dd67b65482720d1ec18e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，坐地铁到汉溪长隆地铁站，7号线还有3号线都可以到，下地铁之后从D出口或者E出口下，搭园区的免费穿梭巴士去到大戏剧院；另有资料称从熊猫酒店步行直达大马戏。","topic_id":"THEME-dc1d19dfd5e6911d0302"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-317471c3dc4b125b9eb0","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"带娃与套餐条件","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-b2692df787868c4f85a0","RULE-c0ac2348b5260f478858"],"summary":"历史资料记载，提到“大马戏带娃”，但原文未给出具体建议或后果；另有“只有拍个3人套餐再单买一个大马戏了”的说法，原文也未给出具体后果。","topic_id":"THEME-fbd8104ab26f5bb42ec5"}]

{"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-87f6363b1c95c8df0c4e"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-87f6363b1c95c8df0c4e","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"观光车调度与换乘","scenic_code":"JZG","source_record_ids":["RULE-052bfd60ec6ea347996b","RULE-34d882d6cf109291b855","RULE-943b0ddad3fd6edec4dd","RULE-b143f3671b315b9f89b8","RULE-ca5fb32c07d5701b50b4","RULE-f74e0f6157df6e48dfd5"],"summary":"历史资料记载，上车后过了中线到诺日朗（Y字交汇处）后，工作人员会听从景区调度决定这辆车开往左线还是右线；每辆车到诺日朗中心后，游客才知道自己要去哪边，观光车终点为随机分配。有游客建议到诺日朗可以下车换乘、不用纠结，别急着逛，先换乘去右线方向；如果上的是左线方向，则到诺日朗中心下车，按指示换乘去右线的车。","topic_id":"THEME-9fabf16b37ef0377a6e1"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-87f6363b1c95c8df0c4e","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"餐饮与用餐位置","scenic_code":"JZG","source_record_ids":["RULE-58efdf29d79cd64848ea","RULE-8859dd6697b5a2cda8b8"],"summary":"历史资料记载，沟内只有诺日朗中心有餐饮，价格偏贵。有游客建议不要被一进去的套餐餐厅和纪念品迷惑，往里面走，走到左线上车点附近，有一个很大的吃饭的地方。","topic_id":"THEME-7bf8aec20abc5b1074fc"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-87f6363b1c95c8df0c4e","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"线路顺序与时间安排","scenic_code":"JZG","source_record_ids":["RULE-40ead07549b7e8195f26","RULE-4208b64555d33a2ce154","RULE-b2fb98725118ca92c4a4","RULE-dfbb28be92ca1c2c5c2b"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从诺日朗到箭竹海（右线）建议坐右边。某游记行程中，第二天第一波进园可玩完整右线加中线，时间充足不赶；另有建议10点左右进园，玩剩余右线加中线，3—4小时搞定。若下午2点前玩完回到诺日朗，可以坐车去左线速通。","topic_id":"THEME-d06a1505f6ea76a10c32"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-87f6363b1c95c8df0c4e","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"诺日朗瀑布步行衔接","scenic_code":"JZG","source_record_ids":["RULE-97591f6b7e7aa26185e4"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议可以从诺日朗中心走去看诺日朗瀑布，看完之后走去站点坐车继续逛中线。","topic_id":"THEME-2133edda4d619e5a316b"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"parent_park","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-10e8a874d4a64eeb","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-80c7fdcee6f3e0f3"],"related_poi_id":"POI-cb24680dd82e15c1","route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"沟内住宿主要分布在诺日朗"},{"attribute":"visit_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-10e8a874d4a64eeb","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS- props.payload_json: {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-41416511e04b9f7b7a39"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-41416511e04b9f7b7a39","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"路线与顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-19ac9b3ee8424f405a95","RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从南门到北门时，金猴王国是最快路径；某游记建议从北门进入后不过桥，直接去左手边的金猴王国，再沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看老虎，下山后顺路喂长颈鹿、看亚洲象园的大象，之后到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，饭后逛考拉园和熊猫村，最后在熊猫乐园站乘缆车返回北门；该建议适用于通常游客有一天时间游览步行园区的情况。","topic_id":"THEME-40f86b4620942ee414cd"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-41416511e04b9f7b7a39","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"人流情况","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-448f464ab725030d4759"],"summary":"历史资料记载，金猴王国是全园人最少的点，很少人走。","topic_id":"THEME-93c762a6841bc25ff2f3"}],"facts":[],"id":"POI-11db8601a1e93894","kind":"POI","name":"金猴王国","observation_ids":["P5OBS-42199bdb7fedd01b","P5OBS-ccfc44ba2d26db4b","P5OBS-4a8c5d84ad6845d5","P5OBS-01318161e92a309f","P5OBS-997aaa6dc34f1f68","P5OBS-89b39e98b90afd60","P5OBS-2472ae6f348c4e6f","P5OBS-16cb7922391c6f8f","P5OBS-3152939b3ca2763b","P5OBS-9b5ef52e85213a47","P5OBS-b9e20db17392f2de"],"recommendation_rule_ids":["RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a"],"restriction_rule_ids":[],"role":"attraction","rule_ids":["RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a","RULE-448f464ab725030d4759","RULE-19ac9b3ee8424f405a95"],"scenic_code":"GZCL","subtype":"spot"}

props.payload_json: {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"入口与园区结构","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-82bfde05c61ca04ce5c9","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955","RULE-d2590492947f44d0f54e","RULE-fbc868516eb5e0dcc213"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆野生动物世界分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口；北门进入后是乘车游览区。湖线是到达北门小火车、青龙山那边的线路。","topic_id":"THEME-20d5dc5d7feb8ac3286f"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"北门进出与路线选择","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1112f4e1005c053b88a9","RULE-3b86ecef31c4167d1452","RULE-6671a2dec2850f51200d","RULE-6d2be13120c07e8d2fb2","RULE-703a5a5727f8a5fd8fa8","RULE-ab0a16dc4fdeed99cab7","RULE-d78a673b62654517bcd9","RULE-e715a9329ea3b62ab4d2","RULE-ef65e590146e3e56ec2a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议导航到长隆野生动物世界北门，并推荐北门进、南门出，单向游览不走回头路，认为动线顺滑；也有游客推荐从南门进北门出。另有游客表示不出北门进路线，因为自己走过几次体验不好，而且人流多、全园逛不了；还有游客称某路线不科学（亲身体验）。若还要回到酒店，有建议从北门出比较方便。北门比较适合旅行团和自驾开车前往。","topic_id":"THEME-7b0d2f5bf1f7fae02714"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"到达北门的交通方式","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-8cb6e20e7677c6813774","RULE-921c004ff1079c85754d","RULE-a3dc1633e4424670bb9b","RULE-c0545b7e1c7a368a8138","RULE-c15717656102cbe32c9a","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，乘坐3号线或7号线至“汉溪长隆站”，从D/E口出站后换乘免费接驳巴士，可直达北门或南门，被认为最省心；也有说法称免费接驳巴士直达北门。官方资料提到出门乘坐免费巴士到达长隆野生动物世界北门。如需从南门前往北门，需要在南门下车后再换乘巴士。若通过公共交通前往长隆野生动物世界，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。","topic_id":"THEME-0c38c4d50c0788488e83"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"北门入园后的小火车与游览顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a","RULE-69d9a2d5c8269628948a","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从北门入园，可先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。有游客建议北门直冲免费小火车；某游记行程中第二天从野生动物园小火车开始，北门进。另有游客给出一天游步行园区的路线：从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看老虎，下山后喂长颈鹿、看亚洲象园的大象，到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，再逛考拉园和熊猫村，然后前往熊猫乐园站乘坐缆车返回北门。","topic_id":"THEME-a944fd0511af3843f1bd"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"停车与到园时间","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-3eb8b8bcae9b633631bb","FACT-9b6b7c456512c5d1d698","RULE-0cc22f49a3e71af4cd9a","RULE-31bdee4b8d7cc97946c4","RULE-3975f8c932204246e940","RULE-72215311b50d55e5c634","RULE-e781cf50698fd7b575f4"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提醒转身就会发现停车场已被管制，得绕好远才能停好车；正确的路线应是北门进，将车停在北门，看到车位就停，别墨迹。另有游客描述从北门进时看到里面还有车位，工作人员指示往前开，于是驶过北门。时间方面，有建议08:50前到北门，赶上第一波进园早、体验好很多；节假日建议9点前到，避免堵车。还有一条提到09:00发车、09:30结束，条件是游客09:30才入园，原文未给出更多后果说明。","topic_id":"THEME-88c196b1367a147a5712"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"表演与避开人流","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-1458f73ae93871761a8f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议从北门进，上午十一点半和下午五点南门有很多场表演，从北门进来两个点的表演都可以看到；也有建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团。","topic_id":"THEME-480980b6b1fd00997e3a"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"parent_park","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-03a3a9a1b18a4491"],"related_poi_id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"北门区(小火车+青龙山)"},{"attribute":"arrival_time","condition":{"clauses":[{"category":"date_time","text":"08:50前到北门"}],"logic":"single","text":"08:50前到北门"},"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"recommended","observation_ids":["P5OBS-585cbb3a61074e74"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"08:50前到北门"},{"attribute":"opening_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-585cbb3a61074e74"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"游客09:30才入园"},{"attribute":"arrival_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-bfeb5a6a8f14e7e7"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"09:00"},{"attribute":"entry_restriction","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-9609ed70867c5b7e"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"从北门进,看到里面还有车位,工作人员指示我们往前开,听着指示我们驶过北门"},{"attribute":"entry_restriction","condition":{"clauses":[{"category":"access","text":"北门进入后"}],"logic":"single","text":"北门进入后"},"entity_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-7bde572911ac8fc7"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"北门进入后是乘车游览区"}],"id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","kind":"POI","name":"长隆野生动物世界北门","observation_ids":["P5OBS-6e6d5de2fb430b30","P5OBS-03a3a9a1b18a4491","P5OBS-b81256e7d118c2e9","P5OBS-3dc4a21a957d9d42","P5OBS-2115709e851f4dc3","P5OBS-585cbb3a61074e74","P5OBS-cf4c39c70b376338","P5OBS-b1d2880298cdbd8e","P5OBS-bfeb5a6a8f14e7e7","P5OBS-4f52773779ba4bd8","P5OBS-6a27662eb775888f","P5OBS-730dc4eae2bf5ca3","P5OBS-f6a7ad63c72492bd","P5OBS-3ebae6a443040adf","P5OBS-ec1b98e1af4f5118","P5OBS-8ff0da1f94f912b4","P5OBS-b4f80208b17acfdc","P5OBS-e6a45fcdcd9292c6","P5OBS-692f31e2537a02a3","P5OBS-8112cfe8d16eea0b","P5OBS-f2a747e94672fa2d","P5OBS-1478964851f144e9","P5OBS-e41e812f8fa1df82","P5OBS-1b9fe513589779cd","P5OBS-396c43cf5b47e5d3","P5OBS-74a3ae8cc6f590e7","P5OBS-9eb7798bfb906e75","P5OBS-ca4b0038e0e9fca3","P5OBS-76cc0f55bdfebde1","P5OBS-2a1f8498eb403176","P5OBS-eb06dabd4846a046","P5OBS-ceeedb9c545737a6","P5OBS-dbafd6125f9398dd","P5OBS-9609ed70867c5b7e","P5OBS-1c651d9d42ce70cb","P5OBS-962d22f37b08ade0","P5OBS-1ef492b715285951","P5OBS-08f37e90cc7495ff","P5OBS-7bde572911ac8fc7"],"recommendation_rule_ids":["RULE-1112f4e1005c053b88a9","RULE-6d2be13120c07e8d2fb2","RULE-e781cf50698fd7b575f4","RULE-ab0a16dc4fdeed99cab7","RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-921c004ff1079c85754d","RULE-31bdee4b8d7cc97946c4","RULE-703a5a57 props.advice_themes_json: [{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"入口与园区结构","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-82bfde05c61ca04ce5c9","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955","RULE-d2590492947f44d0f54e","RULE-fbc868516eb5e0dcc213"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆野生动物世界分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口；北门进入后是乘车游览区。湖线是到达北门小火车、青龙山那边的线路。","topic_id":"THEME-20d5dc5d7feb8ac3286f"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"北门进出与路线选择","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1112f4e1005c053b88a9","RULE-3b86ecef31c4167d1452","RULE-6671a2dec2850f51200d","RULE-6d2be13120c07e8d2fb2","RULE-703a5a5727f8a5fd8fa8","RULE-ab0a16dc4fdeed99cab7","RULE-d78a673b62654517bcd9","RULE-e715a9329ea3b62ab4d2","RULE-ef65e590146e3e56ec2a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议导航到长隆野生动物世界北门，并推荐北门进、南门出，单向游览不走回头路，认为动线顺滑；也有游客推荐从南门进北门出。另有游客表示不出北门进路线，因为自己走过几次体验不好，而且人流多、全园逛不了；还有游客称某路线不科学（亲身体验）。若还要回到酒店，有建议从北门出比较方便。北门比较适合旅行团和自驾开车前往。","topic_id":"THEME-7b0d2f5bf1f7fae02714"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"到达北门的交通方式","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-8cb6e20e7677c6813774","RULE-921c004ff1079c85754d","RULE-a3dc1633e4424670bb9b","RULE-c0545b7e1c7a368a8138","RULE-c15717656102cbe32c9a","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，乘坐3号线或7号线至“汉溪长隆站”，从D/E口出站后换乘免费接驳巴士，可直达北门或南门，被认为最省心；也有说法称免费接驳巴士直达北门。官方资料提到出门乘坐免费巴士到达长隆野生动物世界北门。如需从南门前往北门，需要在南门下车后再换乘巴士。若通过公共交通前往长隆野生动物世界，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。","topic_id":"THEME-0c38c4d50c0788488e83"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"北门入园后的小火车与游览顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a","RULE-69d9a2d5c8269628948a","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从北门入园，可先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。有游客建议北门直冲免费小火车；某游记行程中第二天从野生动物园小火车开始，北门进。另有游客给出一天游步行园区的路线：从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看老虎，下山后喂长颈鹿、看亚洲象园的大象，到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，再逛考拉园和熊猫村，然后前往熊猫乐园站乘坐缆车返回北门。","topic_id":"THEME-a944fd0511af3843f1bd"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"停车与到园时间","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-3eb8b8bcae9b633631bb","FACT-9b6b7c456512c5d1d698","RULE-0cc22f49a3e71af4cd9a","RULE-31bdee4b8d7cc97946c4","RULE-3975f8c932204246e940","RULE-72215311b50d55e5c634","RULE-e781cf50698fd7b575f4"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提醒转身就会发现停车场已被管制，得绕好远才能停好车；正确的路线应是北门进，将车停在北门，看到车位就停，别墨迹。另有游客描述从北门进时看到里面还有车位，工作人员指示往前开，于是驶过北门。时间方面，有建议08:50前到北门，赶上第一波进园早、体验好很多；节假日建议9点前到，避免堵车。还有一条提到09:00发车、09:30结束，条件是游客09:30才入园，原文未给出更多后果说明。","topic_id":"THEME-88c196b1367a147a5712"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-29f1a5a03f663dc57377","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"表演与避开人流","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-1458f73ae93871761a8f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议从北门进，上午十一点半和下午五点南门有很多场表演，从北门进来两个点的表演都可以看到；也有建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团。","topic_id":"THEME-480980b6b1fd00997e3a"}]

{"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"投喂互动与拍照","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-c3131c3551464574dcf0","RULE-354a3aa14913fdb55bb8","RULE-55faaff3b4fc21065f14","RULE-a6465b2958046232be70","RULE-aa98f0d1bca5b04c07e2"],"summary":"历史资料记载，在长颈鹿广场可以给长颈鹿投喂树叶，与它互动拍照打卡；有游客提到可喂长颈鹿最喜爱的桑树和榕树叶。某游记建议把树叶折成几根、多喂几次。若实在不想花钱，官方资料建议等别人投喂时抓拍长颈鹿与你们的合照。","topic_id":"THEME-71f3f0ef10153fd5206d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"投喂费用","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-70e70c384df48cd9dc60","RULE-c50bc03839d6e66e3f50"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长颈鹿吃的树叶一支30元，喂老虎的一盒子肉也是30元；另有游客称花36元买树枝喂长颈鹿以近距离互动。两处价格说法不同，原文未说明差异原因。","topic_id":"THEME-90905017f85fdeb26d1c"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"安全距离","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-1c720f072f0ad113bede","RULE-5db521afc024f66c9e2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，看长颈鹿的时候可要注意不要太近，不然可能会被长颈鹿的口水滴到；另有条目以建议口吻表达同一提醒。","topic_id":"THEME-f0aeea6397ac696d3c20"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览时段疑问","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-ae8d9d65b0afb737471e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提出中心区域如考拉、熊猫、长颈鹿想上午体验还是5点左右开始体验的疑问，原文未给出具体结论或后果。","topic_id":"THEME-b190ee32b74a74a6ce67"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"步行园区路线中的长颈鹿广场","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，某游记建议通常游客有一天时间游览步行园区时，从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，再去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看各种老虎，下山后顺路喂喂长颈鹿、看看亚洲象园的大象，然后到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，饭后逛考拉园和熊猫村，再前往熊猫乐园站乘缆车返回北门。该路线为游记建议，并非人人必须遵循的日序。","topic_id":"THEME-12d1ac1302311df20aa2"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"自驾体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd"], [{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"投喂互动与拍照","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-c3131c3551464574dcf0","RULE-354a3aa14913fdb55bb8","RULE-55faaff3b4fc21065f14","RULE-a6465b2958046232be70","RULE-aa98f0d1bca5b04c07e2"],"summary":"历史资料记载，在长颈鹿广场可以给长颈鹿投喂树叶，与它互动拍照打卡；有游客提到可喂长颈鹿最喜爱的桑树和榕树叶。某游记建议把树叶折成几根、多喂几次。若实在不想花钱，官方资料建议等别人投喂时抓拍长颈鹿与你们的合照。","topic_id":"THEME-71f3f0ef10153fd5206d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"投喂费用","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-70e70c384df48cd9dc60","RULE-c50bc03839d6e66e3f50"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长颈鹿吃的树叶一支30元，喂老虎的一盒子肉也是30元；另有游客称花36元买树枝喂长颈鹿以近距离互动。两处价格说法不同，原文未说明差异原因。","topic_id":"THEME-90905017f85fdeb26d1c"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"安全距离","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-1c720f072f0ad113bede","RULE-5db521afc024f66c9e2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，看长颈鹿的时候可要注意不要太近，不然可能会被长颈鹿的口水滴到；另有条目以建议口吻表达同一提醒。","topic_id":"THEME-f0aeea6397ac696d3c20"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览时段疑问","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-ae8d9d65b0afb737471e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提出中心区域如考拉、熊猫、长颈鹿想上午体验还是5点左右开始体验的疑问，原文未给出具体结论或后果。","topic_id":"THEME-b190ee32b74a74a6ce67"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"步行园区路线中的长颈鹿广场","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，某游记建议通常游客有一天时间游览步行园区时，从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，沿湖看天鹅鹈鹕，再去花果山看猴子，右拐到百虎山看各种老虎，下山后顺路喂喂长颈鹿、看看亚洲象园的大象，然后到熊猫餐厅吃午饭，饭后逛考拉园和熊猫村，再前往熊猫乐园站乘缆车返回北门。该路线为游记建议，并非人人必须遵循的日序。","topic_id":"THEME-12d1ac1302311df20aa2"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9852e51c4b4c84315370","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"自驾体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客表示其选择的是自驾游，并称这成为此行最赞的一个部分；这是个人体验，不构成对长颈鹿广场本身的普遍保证。","topic_id":"THEME-2dfcc791561755d703b9"}]

{"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"缆车与观景","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-07063b49bbf3ac3e7a2c","RULE-1d093a9e6c5ee19b4ac2","RULE-fc6010157868a95053b7"],"summary":"历史资料记载，天鹅湖缆车被列为重点推荐观赏景点之一，与非洲草原、长隆大熊猫中心并列；有游客建议一定要带宝宝们去天鹅湖缆车打卡，称这里能俯视到野生动物世界的全貌，也有游客将其概括为“天鹅湖缆车-看动物园全貌”。","topic_id":"THEME-2d6b75a4d265c4c2674f"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"线路选择与排队","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-7343893fe9ff0db69aee","RULE-9d875ea5dd2733af2c76"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客提醒千万别排错队、排到天鹅湖线；另有资料称天鹅湖线路是一条欣赏自然风光的线路，可俯视整个天鹅湖美景，该说法关联百虎山、天鹅湖、青龙山等线路对象。","topic_id":"THEME-fa8cb8f95620dfb04d99"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"适合人群与寓意","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-c1a251174a2c73a5495a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，官方资料建议情侣们来天鹅湖沾沾天鹅的美好祝愿。","topic_id":"THEME-f2d638fd8d5965867cbf"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"沿途互动","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-c0fd4574bc57724cddfb"],"summary":"历史资料记载，若在天鹅湖到花果山的路边遇到绿色红色的鹦鹉，可以试着跟她们交流下。","topic_id":"THEME-568b4b69114d3bea3db5"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2252377a67c73c076282","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"步行游览顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-50f4dd79d267e811778a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，在通常游客有一天时间游览步行园区的条件下，某游记建议从北门进入，不过桥直接去左手边的金猴王国，然后沿着湖边走看看天鹅鹈鹕，再去花果山看看猴子，然后右拐到百虎山看各种老虎，下山后可以顺路喂喂长颈鹿、调戏下亚洲象园里的大象们；之后到据说是口味最好的熊猫餐厅吃午饭，吃完饭再逛逛考拉园和熊猫村，然后前往熊猫乐园站乘坐缆车返回北门。","topic_id":"THEME-76608d942fa7b7dcbbfb"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"visit_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-41d5eefef861e525","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-d4b5f3114ed33d80"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":"GZCL-NOTE-08-R-fc0bc11cde","step_id":"GZCL-NOTE-08-R-fc0bc11cde-S003","value_text":"10:40-11:20"} props.payload_json: {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-9c4e1c87a3c3dbd3a219"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9c4e1c87a3c3dbd3a219","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"缆车线路与方向","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-c91e20cdada0b32e8b17","RULE-e94c550b0f5239692416"],"summary":"历史资料记载，从熊猫乐园站上车时，缆车通往两个路线：一是通向天鹅湖站（也就是北门），另一个是环线（回到原地）。另有资料建议坐环园线，即从熊猫乐园站经东非草原站、天鹅湖站再回到熊猫乐园站。","topic_id":"THEME-1dd5e7e542b94c9550b5"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-9c4e1c87a3c3dbd3a219","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"观景选择建议","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-07063b49bbf3ac3e7a2c","RULE-7fe6f378c86ea20a5cc1"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客推荐选环园线（熊猫乐园站↔天鹅湖站），称视野最佳；另有游客建议乘天鹅湖缆车看动物园全貌。这些均为游客建议，并非服务保证。","topic_id":"THEME-8d156edc1d6977bed1d0"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"parent_park","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-a5e2ae7adbddb3ba","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-f5761857f8cae66f"],"related_poi_id":"POI-1fc2c78de022d941","route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"天鹅湖站（也就是北门）"}],"id":"POI-a5e2ae7adbddb3ba","kind":"POI","name":"天鹅湖站","observation_ids":["P5OBS-49b57e242f743aee","P5OBS-0c472b871b3880b6","P5OBS-6ab47e3799d79d65","P5OBS-436c0b102c38bec3","P5OBS-7346ae0eee6e92ba","P5OBS-e4fa0d718b10c911","P5OBS-f5761857f8cae66f","P5OBS-399855a1a354db53","P5OBS-a80ff057cb0a7cec","P5OBS-3e9b5e3944e4022c","P5OBS-f0d9e20c50e168d3"],"recommendation_rule_ids":["RULE-07063b49bbf3ac3e7a2c","RULE-7fe6f378c86ea20a5cc1","RULE-e94c550b0f5239692416"],"restriction_rule_ids":[],"role":"support","rule_ids":["RULE-07063b49bbf3ac3e7a2c","RULE-7fe6f378c86ea20a5cc1","RULE-c91e20cdada0b32e8b17","RULE-e94c550b0f5239692416"],"scenic_code":"GZCL","subtype":"station"}

{"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"门票与购票","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ee006777ba81c692da6","RULE-118d803082fbe0ba5356","RULE-1653cc26102c13218873","RULE-1dd65a8474dcf69f36e9","RULE-229fb315a7bf4e7aab37","RULE-297013dda5caeb14ea3e","RULE-2a7138a78bb0934ca256"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客称儿童票和成人票价格一样，260元一张；另有资料称长隆野生动物世界门票300元，小火车和缆车免费乘坐，快捷通道另需150元。购票方面，有游客建议一定要提前网上购票，当天不出票；正常情况下不给改票。提前一天买票有情侣套票，再提前一些有2+1套票（两个大人一个小孩）。每年三四月份属于景区淡季，预订广州长隆酒店客房可以赠送野生动物园的两日票。","topic_id":"THEME-c8db79dc7e37edaa8d7b"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"安检与携带物品","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-208ba10e0caecaae5040","FACT-6b1244376929040b4645","FACT-73919c621d381cd49cc9","FACT-7bc95a1f8bc1083f29ec","FACT-a00a7d9e908cd1ccb562","RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-1a7e7ccd70222c884868","RULE-2436cce1c5fecd978f86","RULE-285f2e364cf95899b602","RULE-400c59eb16935a59c77d","RULE-9196d4b4a9a46782d4a6","RULE-b69a609bd7355daaa5d0","RULE-c2851e7bac0fa27362ba","RULE-e0cb4c4bf3f3fa8d3cf9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，入园时有安检，进园工作人员会要求打开随身携带的包，看到食物会拿出来暂时保管。多条资料称不可以带食物进去，除了水不允许带别的食物；进入园区可以带水，但不能带入食品。也有游客表示只要不随地扔垃圾，带点食物进去是很有必要的，并称里面的东西很不好吃；另有冬天带食物进去的做法（夏天的话自己想办法）。关于投喂，有资料称一般应该是不允许自带食物去投喂动物的。","topic_id":"THEME-5bfc086793bfe23afe8b"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"开放时间与园区布局","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0cdc24bbc1be47a2369c","RULE-11a1347eba22dc3e20fc","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955"],"summary":"历史资料记载，开园时间为09:30-18:00。动物园分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口。动物园内的表演多数集中在中午以后。","topic_id":"THEME-64279434cd282ec78e41"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"交通与入园顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-627e866a69829f85728b","RULE-7e17f5034798bdff5ed8","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba","RULE-d9dca83ab2e746b5b1c5"],"summary":"历史资料记载，如果虎门大桥不堵车，从深圳自驾走沿江高速一个半小时可以抵达；从特别远的停车场出发，步行到动物园至少得四十分钟。有游客建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团；如果通过公共交通前往，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。某游记行程中，第二天早晨坐小火车，然后一直在动物园逛；另一游记行程中，Day2野生动物园从小火车开始，北门进。","topic_id":"THEME-d0e345ff111a0b6d8718"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游玩方式与路线","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-7d4b37c98aa282d1eaa1","RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-05c213fb0912d16b3704","RULE-08b6eb16f48fb0ac5548","RULE-1d2aa2add689a41d11a2","RULE-2950e5f05577e42d9f6a","RULE-2c2fff9a5cac67877127","RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd","RULE-5860c229375c56f5f824","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-95091aac46254dbe384a","RULE-a1b228868709cae375d8","RULE-b1f0f8a55aa7e1a92457","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议第一天主要步行游览；第二天由于体力已经消耗得比较厉害，安排早上自驾游，下午观看表演及动物科普。步行游览区重点是考拉、熊猫、白虎所在中心园区，其他的可以顺路看。野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看；其次考虑乘坐小火车游览，一次没看够可以多次看。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对值得，Mio选择的自驾游也成为此行最赞的部分之一。空中缆车本来就是要坐的，如果能碰巧坐到透明底座的就很幸运。如果不想排队，建议购买快捷通道的门票，还是很划算的。开车入园的话，里面有自驾区，一台车是一张票的价格。提前不做攻略会搞得焦头烂额，建议提前做攻略。","topic_id":"THEME-74e6fb18c9c162a64aee"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"适合人群与亲子服务","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1005d24c799299a1d106","RULE-204db30e69bb1fd7283e","RULE-55fde43696bc0d6c7840","RULE-6ec1c7c5b585ba3a6097","RULE-96dd8cf8bb92945073a3","RULE-a7b5d0e0ce97116bc06c","RULE-c7b17986142f58c174a7","RULE-cc99c9ef68efd3a7eef4","RULE-cf1bd2edf0d67a826f14"],"summary":"历史资料记载，没来过的一定要带孩子来玩玩；更适合情侣和家庭亲子。如果是带宝宝前来游玩，最重要的一件事是带他们去学习动物世界内的科普课程；在每个动物的展区附近，景区都特意开设了面向中、小学生的拯救濒危动物科普教育活动。带6岁以下小孩去，建议租辆婴儿车；也有游客称婴儿车很有必要租。园内有童车租赁服务，对外地游客十分方便，租车使用现金，不支持微信、支付宝。野生动物世界内还有适合小朋友游玩的儿童版跳伞塔、碰碰车和旋转木马等设施，适合亲子互动。对于希望深度游览园区每个角落、体验每个活动的深度游览者，可能需要更加详细的资料。","topic_id":"THEME-d66625c4e0b6610aa381"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"表演与推车限制","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-5200e6f5a782b4431f48","RULE-d93500386820bfe0297f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，所有表演的地方都不可以推车入场；看表演时将车锁在外面栏杆处即可。","topic_id":"THEME-06658c30fa6ccf87c3c6"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"餐饮与购物","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-35eead19b065347c0f12","RULE-83b8f895325cc81e9f2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物世界推荐熊猫餐厅。有游客建议带点食物进去，并称里面的东西很不好吃。在野生动物世界内的小铺子可以买可爱的“萌态”动物玩具、特色物品留念，售价不贵、性价比高，许多玩偶在外面买不到，小朋友很喜欢，有游客建议一定要去“买买买”。","topic_id":"THEME-4481b71ba8d6f33e5d1e"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"行程安排与周边体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-198342f346929f7bc0b5","RULE-29434f65777e7f638d12","RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-39da5c309c279374afb7","RULE-a5b878146e6ef6117bae","RULE-d76f0b3e2311cca512ad","RULE-f491e7a2544f1e466fba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，大部分人去长隆野生动物世界基本是周末或者假期，算上往返和住宿大约两天时间，这份攻略比较适用于大部分普通游客。如果起晚了，可以参考某游记第三天的行程，一个家长带着娃逛动物园，一个家长退房存行李。某游记行程中，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演。有游客表示长隆野生动物世界确实值得一去；趁着南方金秋好天气，可以带上宝贝来一场与动物们的亲密接触；也有官方宣传语称带上你爱的人来长隆野生动物世界数动物，顺便来一场浪漫的空中告白。","topic_id":"THEME-f4cf3ec974920689dd10"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"开园历史","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-3d6b1ee7e615c8e23aa7"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆野生动物世界于1997年开园。","topic_id":"THEME-25e414e0c4b7c0327d9a"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"arrival_time","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-99ab59b1e401a845"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"初四早上八点"},{"attribute":"entry_restriction","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","modality":"required","observation_ids":["P5OBS-3e7f132ef4c58c8b"],"related_poi_id":null,"route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"进入园区需要安检，可以带水，但不能带入食品"},{"attribute":"entry_restriction" [{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"门票与购票","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ee006777ba81c692da6","RULE-118d803082fbe0ba5356","RULE-1653cc26102c13218873","RULE-1dd65a8474dcf69f36e9","RULE-229fb315a7bf4e7aab37","RULE-297013dda5caeb14ea3e","RULE-2a7138a78bb0934ca256"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客称儿童票和成人票价格一样，260元一张；另有资料称长隆野生动物世界门票300元，小火车和缆车免费乘坐，快捷通道另需150元。购票方面，有游客建议一定要提前网上购票，当天不出票；正常情况下不给改票。提前一天买票有情侣套票，再提前一些有2+1套票（两个大人一个小孩）。每年三四月份属于景区淡季，预订广州长隆酒店客房可以赠送野生动物园的两日票。","topic_id":"THEME-c8db79dc7e37edaa8d7b"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"安检与携带物品","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-208ba10e0caecaae5040","FACT-6b1244376929040b4645","FACT-73919c621d381cd49cc9","FACT-7bc95a1f8bc1083f29ec","FACT-a00a7d9e908cd1ccb562","RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-1a7e7ccd70222c884868","RULE-2436cce1c5fecd978f86","RULE-285f2e364cf95899b602","RULE-400c59eb16935a59c77d","RULE-9196d4b4a9a46782d4a6","RULE-b69a609bd7355daaa5d0","RULE-c2851e7bac0fa27362ba","RULE-e0cb4c4bf3f3fa8d3cf9"],"summary":"历史资料记载，入园时有安检，进园工作人员会要求打开随身携带的包，看到食物会拿出来暂时保管。多条资料称不可以带食物进去，除了水不允许带别的食物；进入园区可以带水，但不能带入食品。也有游客表示只要不随地扔垃圾，带点食物进去是很有必要的，并称里面的东西很不好吃；另有冬天带食物进去的做法（夏天的话自己想办法）。关于投喂，有资料称一般应该是不允许自带食物去投喂动物的。","topic_id":"THEME-5bfc086793bfe23afe8b"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"开放时间与园区布局","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0cdc24bbc1be47a2369c","RULE-11a1347eba22dc3e20fc","RULE-c82b9b1dfb1ed2f92955"],"summary":"历史资料记载，开园时间为09:30-18:00。动物园分为步行区（各地珍奇动物）与乘车游览区（放养野生动物）两个部分，分南门和北门两个入口。动物园内的表演多数集中在中午以后。","topic_id":"THEME-64279434cd282ec78e41"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"交通与入园顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0ef8f6fbadf6f8544cc9","RULE-4a2bf0b85b5bed112611","RULE-627e866a69829f85728b","RULE-7e17f5034798bdff5ed8","RULE-d5b46fa12844ce6985ba","RULE-d9dca83ab2e746b5b1c5"],"summary":"历史资料记载，如果虎门大桥不堵车，从深圳自驾走沿江高速一个半小时可以抵达；从特别远的停车场出发，步行到动物园至少得四十分钟。有游客建议上午从北门进野生动物园，避开旅行团；如果通过公共交通前往，可以在北门附近乘坐小火车游览。某游记行程中，第二天早晨坐小火车，然后一直在动物园逛；另一游记行程中，Day2野生动物园从小火车开始，北门进。","topic_id":"THEME-d0e345ff111a0b6d8718"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游玩方式与路线","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-7d4b37c98aa282d1eaa1","RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-05c213fb0912d16b3704","RULE-08b6eb16f48fb0ac5548","RULE-1d2aa2add689a41d11a2","RULE-2950e5f05577e42d9f6a","RULE-2c2fff9a5cac67877127","RULE-429de54a81b4983a6efd","RULE-5860c229375c56f5f824","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-95091aac46254dbe384a","RULE-a1b228868709cae375d8","RULE-b1f0f8a55aa7e1a92457","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe"],"summary":"历史资料记载，有游客建议第一天主要步行游览；第二天由于体力已经消耗得比较厉害，安排早上自驾游，下午观看表演及动物科普。步行游览区重点是考拉、熊猫、白虎所在中心园区，其他的可以顺路看。野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看；其次考虑乘坐小火车游览，一次没看够可以多次看。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对值得，Mio选择的自驾游也成为此行最赞的部分之一。空中缆车本来就是要坐的，如果能碰巧坐到透明底座的就很幸运。如果不想排队，建议购买快捷通道的门票，还是很划算的。开车入园的话，里面有自驾区，一台车是一张票的价格。提前不做攻略会搞得焦头烂额，建议提前做攻略。","topic_id":"THEME-74e6fb18c9c162a64aee"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"适合人群与亲子服务","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1005d24c799299a1d106","RULE-204db30e69bb1fd7283e","RULE-55fde43696bc0d6c7840","RULE-6ec1c7c5b585ba3a6097","RULE-96dd8cf8bb92945073a3","RULE-a7b5d0e0ce97116bc06c","RULE-c7b17986142f58c174a7","RULE-cc99c9ef68efd3a7eef4","RULE-cf1bd2edf0d67a826f14"],"summary":"历史资料记载，没来过的一定要带孩子来玩玩；更适合情侣和家庭亲子。如果是带宝宝前来游玩，最重要的一件事是带他们去学习动物世界内的科普课程；在每个动物的展区附近，景区都特意开设了面向中、小学生的拯救濒危动物科普教育活动。带6岁以下小孩去，建议租辆婴儿车；也有游客称婴儿车很有必要租。园内有童车租赁服务，对外地游客十分方便，租车使用现金，不支持微信、支付宝。野生动物世界内还有适合小朋友游玩的儿童版跳伞塔、碰碰车和旋转木马等设施，适合亲子互动。对于希望深度游览园区每个角落、体验每个活动的深度游览者，可能需要更加详细的资料。","topic_id":"THEME-d66625c4e0b6610aa381"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"表演与推车限制","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-5200e6f5a782b4431f48","RULE-d93500386820bfe0297f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，所有表演的地方都不可以推车入场；看表演时将车锁在外面栏杆处即可。","topic_id":"THEME-06658c30fa6ccf87c3c6"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"餐饮与购物","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-16495cd1e5e1d47edddd","RULE-35eead19b065347c0f12","RULE-83b8f895325cc81e9f2c"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物世界推荐熊猫餐厅。有游客建议带点食物进去，并称里面的东西很不好吃。在野生动物世界内的小铺子可以买可爱的“萌态”动物玩具、特色物品留念，售价不贵、性价比高，许多玩偶在外面买不到，小朋友很喜欢，有游客建议一定要去“买买买”。","topic_id":"THEME-4481b71ba8d6f33e5d1e"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"行程安排与周边体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-198342f346929f7bc0b5","RULE-29434f65777e7f638d12","RULE-2b62d4d5d011bd62f2c5","RULE-39da5c309c279374afb7","RULE-a5b878146e6ef6117bae","RULE-d76f0b3e2311cca512ad","RULE-f491e7a2544f1e466fba"],"summary":"历史资料记载，大部分人去长隆野生动物世界基本是周末或者假期，算上往返和住宿大约两天时间，这份攻略比较适用于大部分普通游客。如果起晚了，可以参考某游记第三天的行程，一个家长带着娃逛动物园，一个家长退房存行李。某游记行程中，白天在长隆野生动物世界游玩丰富多彩、充满奇趣，晚上可以去长隆国际大马戏剧院欣赏马戏表演。有游客表示长隆野生动物世界确实值得一去；趁着南方金秋好天气，可以带上宝贝来一场与动物们的亲密接触；也有官方宣传语称带上你爱的人来长隆野生动物世界数动物，顺便来一场浪漫的空中告白。","topic_id":"THEME-f4cf3ec974920689dd10"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-a4858a0451ebf42c9e56","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"开园历史","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-3d6b1ee7e615c8e23aa7"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆野生动物世界于1997年开园。","topic_id":"THEME-25e414e0c4b7c0327d9a"}]

props.payload_json: {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-20145ab0ca5f70777630","ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与入园","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1346a7811c46a1ccaffb","RULE-69d9a2d5c8269628948a","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车和缆车都包含在门票里，不用另付费；有游客建议从北门入园后直冲免费小火车。某游记建议从北门入园，先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；另有官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面可以先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。","topic_id":"THEME-64c4ec2fba985f1ebb6d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游玩与排队","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-4bf17c96477dbc04dc04","FACT-8af72dc4149482f46a75","FACT-cd90af91f153761788ba","FACT-d26c01fd30a639ecad63","FACT-f31c34cfbfcf00380388","RULE-1fc2d10ee70274ad3902","RULE-251c5b00a02fe1e1a4d6","RULE-25776f6db426771fc64a","RULE-57e8e7dd39563dff8b0a","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-8192e18d02198b65e7eb","RULE-c05fa95447dcb618967a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，非节假日小火车乘车点排队约35分钟；有游客表示下午排队人多，建议先冲小火车。有游客建议上午动物们精神最好时进门直接冲小火车。小火车全程约40分钟，穿越五大洲草原，看长颈鹿、斑马、狮子、河马自由漫步；另有资料称全程约40分钟、短短几十分钟，也有资料称游玩时间在2小时左右，说法不一。有游客表示小火车很难拍出好照片，但仍值得乘坐去看看那些动物；有游客建议一次没看够可以多次看。","topic_id":"THEME-72548aa76fff79447e98"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"座位与观赏方向","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-2cd86f1540184ad694b5","RULE-9e14154b27aec485d8f7","RULE-ddda458b84d72a559c8c","RULE-edf52f9b598aa7375108"],"summary":"历史资料记载，由于大部分动物都在小火车的右侧，且小火车是4个人一排，每个排队的队伍最后一个人会坐在最好的位置。有游客建议坐右侧，动物更多；有游客称必坐右侧座位，长颈鹿、斑马、狮子、犀牛、大象更多集中在右侧，近距离观感最好；另有游客称小火车必坐右侧。","topic_id":"THEME-f946481dc5954fae87b9"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"自驾与小火车选择","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-0c4c4919d46656795027","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-6e1b07f826e9514151da","RULE-7b2d49b07fe6cead6a58","RULE-9524f6efd44e69a9b544","RULE-9be61d0f8f84a8283b71","RULE-adcce58d1cd4c6b69fbd","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe","RULE-bf871d3d7c3654d6c926","RULE-e4880d8496d46d2bd666"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物散养区域可以通过自驾车或者小火车游览，西边的乘车游览区可以自驾或者乘坐小火车。平日自驾车游览野生动物放养区域，每辆车需要额外支付300元费用；周末自驾车游览野生动物放养区域，每辆车需要额外支付350元费用。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对只是值得的，自驾车最大好处是可以想停就停，非常适合拍摄野生状态下的动物；有游客建议野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看，其次考虑乘坐小火车游览。另有资料称可以自由选择停留地点，可开车窗；有游客建议乘坐小火车游览。","topic_id":"THEME-cb2b25c717173acaa151"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览路线与顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0cc22f49a3e71af4cd9a","RULE-7d3e1269b6ee6948e971","RULE-936523545ffc16502762","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，某游记建议正确的路线应该是：北门进，将车停在北门，看到车位就停，别墨迹。官方资料建议从北门入园，先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；另有官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面可以先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。有游客建议搭乘小火车游览，第一站是澳洲森林，可看到大赤袋鼠、考拉与袋鼠等野生动物；有游客建议坐小火车穿越非洲草原。","topic_id":"THEME-7ea8e206c85226faa089"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览内容与体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-124403f84d24f126b84f","RULE-781bba6ac6b990b3035c","RULE-fcf7bca440f3ebead2b1"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车全程穿越“五大洲”，沉浸式和百兽同行；乘坐森林小火车，穿越五大洲的珍稀动物世界，近距离接触可爱的动物朋友。有游客表示精华是小火车和缆车。","topic_id":"THEME-7b5b1ea4a185ca2803ad"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"禁止事项","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-e8aa9b5c2747db239732","RULE-fafd824f7c5dccd0e99e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车游览区不可喂食，中途不可下车。","topic_id":"THEME-0901c782258336e9ba43"}],"facts":[{"attribute":"parent_park","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-ec55746728ce0d93"],"related_poi_id":"POI-a62c2af16093cd29","route_id":null,"step_id":null,"value_text":"北门区(小火车+青龙山)"},{"attribute":"recommended_stay","condition":null,"entity_id":"POI-a861b1470d96ab5f","modality":"asserted","observation_ids":["P5OBS-e32c2f18872b7b94"],"related_poi_ [{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与入园","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-1346a7811c46a1ccaffb","RULE-69d9a2d5c8269628948a","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车和缆车都包含在门票里，不用另付费；有游客建议从北门入园后直冲免费小火车。某游记建议从北门入园，先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；另有官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面可以先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。","topic_id":"THEME-64c4ec2fba985f1ebb6d"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游玩与排队","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-4bf17c96477dbc04dc04","FACT-8af72dc4149482f46a75","FACT-cd90af91f153761788ba","FACT-d26c01fd30a639ecad63","FACT-f31c34cfbfcf00380388","RULE-1fc2d10ee70274ad3902","RULE-251c5b00a02fe1e1a4d6","RULE-25776f6db426771fc64a","RULE-57e8e7dd39563dff8b0a","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-8192e18d02198b65e7eb","RULE-c05fa95447dcb618967a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，非节假日小火车乘车点排队约35分钟；有游客表示下午排队人多，建议先冲小火车。有游客建议上午动物们精神最好时进门直接冲小火车。小火车全程约40分钟，穿越五大洲草原，看长颈鹿、斑马、狮子、河马自由漫步；另有资料称全程约40分钟、短短几十分钟，也有资料称游玩时间在2小时左右，说法不一。有游客表示小火车很难拍出好照片，但仍值得乘坐去看看那些动物；有游客建议一次没看够可以多次看。","topic_id":"THEME-72548aa76fff79447e98"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"座位与观赏方向","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-2cd86f1540184ad694b5","RULE-9e14154b27aec485d8f7","RULE-ddda458b84d72a559c8c","RULE-edf52f9b598aa7375108"],"summary":"历史资料记载，由于大部分动物都在小火车的右侧，且小火车是4个人一排，每个排队的队伍最后一个人会坐在最好的位置。有游客建议坐右侧，动物更多；有游客称必坐右侧座位，长颈鹿、斑马、狮子、犀牛、大象更多集中在右侧，近距离观感最好；另有游客称小火车必坐右侧。","topic_id":"THEME-f946481dc5954fae87b9"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"自驾与小火车选择","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0136d3ffff7959dbf6c0","RULE-0c4c4919d46656795027","RULE-6713bd5d4eb5ebb9b619","RULE-6e1b07f826e9514151da","RULE-7b2d49b07fe6cead6a58","RULE-9524f6efd44e69a9b544","RULE-9be61d0f8f84a8283b71","RULE-adcce58d1cd4c6b69fbd","RULE-be4da62486d19982f2fe","RULE-bf871d3d7c3654d6c926","RULE-e4880d8496d46d2bd666"],"summary":"历史资料记载，野生动物散养区域可以通过自驾车或者小火车游览，西边的乘车游览区可以自驾或者乘坐小火车。平日自驾车游览野生动物放养区域，每辆车需要额外支付300元费用；周末自驾车游览野生动物放养区域，每辆车需要额外支付350元费用。有游客表示自驾350块钱绝对只是值得的，自驾车最大好处是可以想停就停，非常适合拍摄野生状态下的动物；有游客建议野生放养区域体验最佳，优先考虑自驾慢慢看，其次考虑乘坐小火车游览。另有资料称可以自由选择停留地点，可开车窗；有游客建议乘坐小火车游览。","topic_id":"THEME-cb2b25c717173acaa151"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览路线与顺序","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-0cc22f49a3e71af4cd9a","RULE-7d3e1269b6ee6948e971","RULE-936523545ffc16502762","RULE-99ab319df04f64db5a92","RULE-f452b3d4292a605d7078"],"summary":"历史资料记载，某游记建议正确的路线应该是：北门进，将车停在北门，看到车位就停，别墨迹。官方资料建议从北门入园，先乘坐小火车游览一遍，然后一路向南；另有官方资料建议从北门入园，在天鹅美食对面可以先乘坐小火车游玩乘车游览部分。有游客建议搭乘小火车游览，第一站是澳洲森林，可看到大赤袋鼠、考拉与袋鼠等野生动物；有游客建议坐小火车穿越非洲草原。","topic_id":"THEME-7ea8e206c85226faa089"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"游览内容与体验","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-124403f84d24f126b84f","RULE-781bba6ac6b990b3035c","RULE-fcf7bca440f3ebead2b1"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车全程穿越“五大洲”，沉浸式和百兽同行；乘坐森林小火车，穿越五大洲的珍稀动物世界，近距离接触可爱的动物朋友。有游客表示精华是小火车和缆车。","topic_id":"THEME-7b5b1ea4a185ca2803ad"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-2fe2b991b9fce9e7c753","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"禁止事项","scenic_code":"GZCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-e8aa9b5c2747db239732","RULE-fafd824f7c5dccd0e99e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，小火车游览区不可喂食，中途不可下车。","topic_id":"THEME-0901c782258336e9ba43"}]

props.payload_json: {"advice_summary_ids":["ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b"],"advice_themes":[{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与入园凭证","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-325203c05ec730e44358","FACT-547337519b0ec0af1651","RULE-1b9391d2fdef85939383","RULE-1c2ca1de40df890c5e1c","RULE-6e54d213335948db1a09","RULE-d9fe033ec83273170007"],"summary":"历史资料记载，购票成功后需要预约出行；游客进入园区前须在入口处接受体温测量筛检、有效身份证明文件核对及“健康码”（包括粤康码、穗康码等）核验，并建议提前准备好身份证/港澳居民来往内地通行证/台湾居民来往大陆通行证/居留许可证/护照等有效身份证明文件、“健康码”以及预约入园凭证。该1大1小亲子票需至少在出游前一天23:59前预订；该特惠产品每日不超过1000张全渠道限量销售，先订先得。","topic_id":"THEME-6be322d31f97ae8a4032"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"防疫与口罩要求","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-480a1b4fe2376cb0edec","FACT-9e3d54387ca1fca20815","FACT-d2aa6805e1d47c1ea90d","RULE-33a7e8f7e6fcc773ef14","RULE-3e9d79f7913a0a48254d","RULE-a7bd6860568b81c99a1a","RULE-ab76237a0b28dc2c2342"],"summary":"历史资料记载，所有游客在进入园区时必须佩戴好口罩，主动出示“健康码”及“行程码”，并配合工作人员做好体温检测及实名登记工作。行程码带“*”者根据防疫实时要求接待；中高风险地区和健康码及行程码为黄码、红码者园区暂时无法接待。若在进入园区前途径或所在地区的风险状态突然发生变化，可能会被拒绝进入。","topic_id":"THEME-8a521b4a23da94bc4567"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"适合人群与游玩节奏","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-077e34653efaf08271da","RULE-2c70fafcb6a29d1e0600","RULE-44b92ba3f9aae90a965e","RULE-82c9d07081b353bc80be","RULE-88c274468f239a93bc7a"],"summary":"历史资料记载，珠海长隆海洋王国园区规模不大，一天可以走完，两日游较轻松，是广东地区及周边短途亲子游以及周末亲子游可以重点选择的地方；有游客表示长隆海洋王国太适合亲子游玩儿了，但也有游客评价“很—般般不推荐”。某游记建议珠海长隆三天两夜最划算，一天海洋王国、一天水上乐园；另有游记建议海洋王国三天两晚门票含酒店，自驾便捷。","topic_id":"THEME-b13fc721f446fdbb9a88"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"提前入园与排队","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-40543a3a787003e611ba","FACT-b67dfc20fd50b5f8c74b","FACT-e17a2291c3149dd61826","RULE-2a9cd7284a0312d58ec2","RULE-46173d585e37a4c1420c","RULE-57efd2aea65f307dd955","RULE-87820c8c2fc6f83f0d12","RULE-8bc98c935ea2cee864dc","RULE-dfab1ea160f1e9804a53","RULE-f473fbe15d49b1400d66"],"summary":"历史资料记载，旅游旺季提前1小时入园，能省出至少3小时的排队时间；有游客建议海洋王国提前一小时入园，推荐早起。如果是长隆酒店入住者可以提前1小时入园；住客可提前入园；凭房卡可以提前1小时入园（该条属线路专属信息）。有游客表示跟秋游大军错开玩了，海洋王国其实都没等过，所以觉得有优速通也用不上。海洋王国有一项海洋特快优先入场服务，可以使用专用通道优先通行重点游乐设施、进入剧场观赏精彩表演，节省排队等候时间。另有游客称无绿色通道，进园需要排队。","topic_id":"THEME-35d4c66f4362b9be52cd"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"身高与免票规则","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-393fd93c8533ccda6741","FACT-43818dd657b0df4df946"],"summary":"历史资料记载，对身高检查特别严格，会拿着尺子量。1名购票成人（大学生票、优待票等优惠票种除外）仅限携带1名身高未达1.0米的免票儿童入园（大学生票、优待票等优惠票种除外）。","topic_id":"THEME-b0a649772ddf11eea4c3"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"餐饮与携带物品","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-9ce1f1dae4e4b95e4732","FACT-c44268b799de60c65d8a","FACT-eb1074cc3414b65aec70","RULE-6095869e552bdc63c207","RULE-8f607e7bcc2af02008cf","RULE-b6ce71f18b750414737f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，可以带水跟面包饼干类进园区；不可带饭盒熟食进园；为保证园区动物安全，除婴儿食品和本人适量饮用水外，谢绝游客带入其它食品和饮品；不可带饭盒熟食进园。另有资料称可以带水跟面包饼干类进园区。","topic_id":"THEME-048bd7493891bc4c7def"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"地图、推车与入园准备","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-3a2022fd65c830a73957","RULE-5b22dbf75103aa328172","RULE-68f7de69f17bfcd5df77","RULE-6ec5011ff4f39a9ef201","RULE-d01477c8c708025efea0","RULE-f41b407a64185610642e"],"summary":"历史资料记载，进园后可在深海世界门口（左边）拿一份景点游玩地图；地图有中文版、英文版，不要拿错了；也可以使用二维码扫描出的电子地图。带着宝宝一定要带一辆推车，如果没有可以在入园处租借一辆；租借推车要注意归还的时间。进园录入指纹，这样就可以2日无限次入园了。","topic_id":"THEME-2c521e215b65dd9f7c9f"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"交通与住宿选择","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-03ace5fb6ef00ce4d799","RULE-40772071e0180c967f91","RULE-42d0622351334fd08df0","RULE-72f57db8156aafa78245","RULE-7473103452e1fdd30535","RULE-9ab6ba49e2a371d5da81"],"summary":"历史资料记载，到达度假区后，选择步行或免费穿梭巴士到达度假区内各目的地；到海洋王国步行约10分钟，可以坐巴士前往，也可以走路。去时打车一定定位珠海长隆海洋王国正门，下车走几步就是入口。珠海横琴长隆海洋王国有4个酒店可供选择，这次安排入住长隆横琴湾酒店，口碑极好的还有企鹅酒店、马戏酒店，还有一个长隆迎海酒店公寓；如果住飞船酒店玩儿海洋王国就有点远。还没到暑假、又是周中淡季时，价钱非常合适，1450rmb包括了一晚上酒店住宿含双早以及2张海洋王国2日无限次入园的门票。","topic_id":"THEME-334e536f2a95b557d5bd"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"预约与入园","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-7aece809b5ff05089458","FACT-899ab90fa17570a16555","FACT-f29eb58b23de47dbdc6a","RULE-580d4c7ce8ab4a32b1ec","RULE-6b52f528fa1aa47abbc5","RULE-6e8b1486c8f37be021fc","RULE-74f1fc201125132c8c33","RULE-7a0a3ec14919adc5d9da","RULE-a32abdcc76bf3dc216e6","RULE-a8616cc11c4f9dab22b7","RULE-e62c073d96de6776235f"],"summary":"历史资料记载，购票成功后需要预约出行；购买1大1小亲子票时，请选定适用日期内其中一天为游玩日期。入园建议8点45分就可以去排队，也可以提前一点排队、准备进行安检。住园区酒店可提前1小时入园，凭房卡可以提前1小时入园；住客可提前入园。另有资料提到09:00提前一小时入园。","topic_id":"THEME-b8e1d4043a84dbb2613f"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"健康与防疫限制","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-2aba6bb6da6d8180dde7","RULE-73507d353addd2d49e41"],"summary":"历史资料记载，园区暂时无法接待中高风险地区和健康码及行程码为黄码、红码者；行程码带“*”者建议提前致电客服进行确认。","topic_id":"THEME-c68cf65ed3fdf496b3e4"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"适合人群与亲子体验","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["FACT-a1286a0bbfc8f50feef9","RULE-3e3a14080c27b6bcf0b2","RULE-4029b0a826d1bbd407bb","RULE-72619faf6737d55a1cfc","RULE-9c931a07baa0cc105605","RULE-9d1f2734f18ff4fbe446","RULE-ea835dd0eee429afef08"],"summary":"历史资料记载，长隆海洋王国适合亲子旅游，适合带孩子旅游探索海洋世界；园区面积并不大，相比广州长隆更加适合带孩子亲子游。带小宝宝时，园区内可供小宝宝玩的游乐设备几乎没有，都有身高限制。海洋王国对身高检查特别严格，会拿着尺子量。有游客表示长隆确实值得一去，是值得二刷三刷的地方。","topic_id":"THEME-d9cb2290b498dfc595a9"},{"advice_summary_id":"ADVICE-b56d14bfc0f3bdab8a6b","current_validity_verified":false,"label":"门票与儿童免票","scenic_code":"ZHCL","source_record_ids":["RULE-03cb6b97b792f87acbee","RULE-3dfe33eef33ba1bf20a9","RULE-74f1fc201125132c
